concerns.text: The plan mentions a fallback to a pre‑computed connectivity matrix (see Quickstart) but does not document this fallback in the implementation plan itself. Principle II of the constitution forbids silent fallbacks; the plan should explicitly state the fallback behavior, its conditions, and how it is logged.

The Phase Plan lists tasks linked to FR/SC but never references the concrete data‑model entities (Participant, StructuralConnectome, AvalancheRecord, CorrelationResult). For full Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency each step should name the entity it produces or consumes.
